name: Imgur
label: Imgur API v3
description: Official Imgur API v3. Client-ID header for anonymous. image_upload accepts an image URL (not multipart file — OfficialApiNode JSON/URL). image_get, album_get, gallery_search. Commercial use requires RapidAPI routing per Imgur docs.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for Imgur. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"image_upload"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: image_upload | image_get | album_get | gallery_search. Example: 'image_upload'.

schema.label: image
schema.description: image_upload REQUIRED. HTTPS image URL (not inline bytes). Example: https://example.com/pic.png.

schema.label: type
schema.description: url when sending a URL. Example: url.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: time | viral | top. Default via path. Example: time.

schema.label: window
schema.description: day | week | month | year | all. Example: week.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: image_upload | image_get | album_get | gallery_search. Example: 'image_upload'.

configurationParameters.label: Client Id
configurationParameters.description: Imgur client_id. Header Authorization: Client-ID. Free tier non-commercial. Commercial: RapidAPI https://apidocs.imgur.com/

configurationParameters.label: Gallery sort
configurationParameters.description: Path default for gallery_search. EXACT: time | viral | top. Overridable from input.sort. Example: time.

configurationParameters.label: Gallery window
configurationParameters.description: Path default for gallery_search when sort=top. EXACT: day | week | month | year | all. Overridable from input.window. Example: all.

configurationParameters.label: Gallery page
configurationParameters.description: Path default for gallery_search. 0-based page. Overridable from input.page. Example: 0.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
